newsitem.title: USA: EMC enters agreement with Computer Network.
newsitem.headline: EMC enters agreement with Computer Network.

text.p: EMC Corp and Computer Network Technology Corp (CNT) on Thursday said they entered an agreement under which the companies have made their key computer products compatible.

Under the pact, EMC's Symmetrix Remote Data Facility (SRDF) business continuance software and CNT's Channelink networking product line will function together, providing a computer back-up system that can be maintained from remote locations.
Beta testing with selected customers is under way, the companies said.
EMC provides information storage and retrieval systems, and CNT develops networking products.
